music_shuffle_state.position_policy: Keep the song and shuffle position between menus, Crib and draft. Games follow the retail Crib Music setting: with Crib/Menus/Game the list plays in game and the crowd loop is off, as in retail; otherwise the song stops for the game, the full crowd plays and the song restarts on return. Pause and replay screens keep in-game music playing. Stadium clip previews pause and resume it. Loading, halftime, wrap-up and jukebox previews stop the background song; it restarts on return. One selected song repeats; zero stops.
music_shuffle_state.context_proof_scope: 24 named native routes, bounded with rendering and streaming stubs; gameplay unwitnessed

modern_naming_details.retail:
Franchise Milestones are achieved in Franchise Mode by the team you've assigned to your VIP.

These Milestones are based on the statistical and win/loss record accomplishments of both individuals on your team as well as the team as a whole.

There are no Option Settings requirements for these Milestones and they may also be achieved in Simulation Mode.
